template.name: Mindray Sidestream CO2 Module – AS/NZS 3551 PVT
template.desc: Sidestream CO2 module (plugs into the monitor): visual, leak test and CO2 accuracy. From the CHS Ansur template “Side Stream CO2 module AS-NZS 3551 PVT”. No electrical safety tests: the host monitor’s are done on the monitor.

steps.title: Visual inspection
steps.instructions: Inspect the module, its cables and its connectors. Do not open the module.

items: The case, display screen, buttons, power cord, and accessories have no obvious signs of damage.
The external connecting cables are not frayed and the connector pins are not loose or bent.
The external connectors are not loose and their pins are not bent.
The safety labels and data plate are clearly legible.
The power-on test is passed. The power indicator and alarm system works correctly and the monitor starts up properly.
CO2 Leak Test: Block the gas inlet of the module or watertrap. The sidestream CO2 flowrate is slower than 10ml/min and an alarm of CO2 Filterline Err is given. It indicates that there is no leakage.

readings.label: CO2 Accuracy Test: The displayed CO2 value is within 6.0±0.3%.
